literal: The small resentment that arises from feigned anger, even if great affection withers, will obtain greatness.
translation: The brief resentment that arises from a lover's tiff, even if it temporarily withers their deep affection, ultimately brings a greater beauty to their love.
modern: ஊடலினால் உண்டாகும் சிறிய வருத்தம், நல்ல அன்பு தற்காலிகமாக வாடினாலும், முடிவில் பெருமையையே தரும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how a minor misunderstanding or feigned anger enhances love. The small resentment that arises during such a tiff might make their deep affection seem to wither temporarily. However, this brief period of distance actually intensifies their desire for each other. Ultimately, this experience gains greater value by making their reunion and subsequent love much sweeter.
